about.heading: About Me
about.body: Software Engineer with over five years of experience building scalable solutions and cloud infrastructure. My expertise lies in backend development with Python, Java, Kotlin, and C#, alongside designing and managing cloud solutions in Azure, AWS, and GCP using Terraform. I have built microservices architectures, led technical decisions as a tech lead, and worked on AI-powered SaaS products. I work equally well independently and in a team, with a focus on clean software design and experience with Agile methodologies.
